Control Description: Password policy requiring 12+ characters and SSO with MFA via Google Workspace for all staff.
Notes: Strong alignment; maps to both password management (A.5.17) and MFA enforcement (A.8.5).

Control Description: Automated daily encrypted snapshots of production AWS RDS databases with 30-day retention.
Notes: Direct 1-to-1 match. Verify periodic restore testing during the gap analysis.

Control Description: Quarterly access reviews of AWS and GitHub admin accounts conducted by the Engineering Lead.
Notes: Clean mapping. Confirm review sign-offs are logged as audit evidence.

Control Description: Mandatory security awareness onboarding slides for new hires during their first week.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.6.3 (Information security awareness, education and training)
Notes: Covers onboarding, but lacks recurring annual refreshers and completion tracking required for full compliance.

Control Description: HR notifies IT via a Jira ticket within 24 hours of employee offboarding to revoke all SaaS and VPN access.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.5.18 (Access rights); A.6.5 (Responsibilities after termination or change of employment)
Notes: Clear operational workflow with a ticketed audit trail.

Control Description: All company laptops run full-disk encryption (FileVault/BitLocker) and SentinelOne EDR.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.8.1 (User endpoint devices); A.8.7 (Protection against malware); A.8.24 (Use of cryptography)
Notes: Covers endpoint hardening, anti-malware, and encryption at rest.

Control Description: TLS 1.3 enforced for all customer-facing web traffic and AES-256 encryption on S3 buckets.
Notes: Direct match. Gap analysis should check for a formal cryptographic key management policy.

Control Description: Separate AWS accounts and CI/CD pipelines for Development, Staging, and Production environments.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.8.31 (Separation of development, test and production environments)

Control Description: GitHub branch protection requires at least one peer code review and passing automated tests before merging to main.
Notes: Spans two clauses cleanly, but lacks explicit security-focused review criteria (e.g., OWASP checklist) for full A.8.28 coverage.

Control Description: Monthly automated vulnerability scans on production containers using Trivy, with ad-hoc patching.
Notes: Detection maps cleanly, but ad-hoc patching lacks defined remediation SLAs by severity.

Control Description: Centralized AWS CloudTrail and application logs retained for 90 days in Datadog.
Notes: Strong technical match; verify log integrity/immutability protections.

Control Description: Background checks performed by a third-party vendor for all full-time engineering hires.
Notes: Maps well for full-time engineers, but contractors and non-engineering staff are currently excluded.

Control Description: Employees report suspected phishing or security issues in a shared #security-alerts Slack channel.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.6.8 (Information security event reporting); A.5.24 (Information security incident management planning and preparation)
Notes: Does not map cleanly. Informal Slack reporting lacks structured triage, severity classification, escalation paths, and formal incident logs.

Control Description: Verbal reminders from managers during monthly all-hands meetings to lock laptops when working in cafes.
ISO 27001 Clause: A.7.7 (Clear desk and clear screen); A.7.9 (Security of assets off-premises)
Notes: Does not map cleanly. Verbal reminders are not auditable or enforceable controls; requires a written policy and MDM screen-lock enforcement.

Control Description: Active $1M cyber liability insurance policy renewed annually through a broker.
ISO 27001 Clause: N/A - No direct Annex A clause (Relates to Clause 6.1.3 Information security risk treatment)
Notes: Does not map cleanly to Annex A. Cyber insurance is a financial risk-transfer mechanism under Clause 6.1.3, not a preventive/detective Annex A security control.
